title: Gotrade Daily: Nvidia Reports Tonight, All Eyes on AI
summary: Nvidia reports earnings tonight, the biggest test yet for the AI trade. Here is the watchlist and key catalysts before July PCE inflation data.
body_markdown:
### A signal from the chip supply chain


**Synopsys ([SNPS](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/snps/) )** , which builds chip-design (EDA) software, gives an early read on how busy the semiconductor industry is. It is a useful complement for reading the health of the whole AI complex, not just one company.


## Pre-Market Pulse 📊


As this note is written, the US market is still hours from the pre-market open, so early price action is not yet available. The Movement column in the Watchlist will be filled near publish time, once index-futures direction (S&P 500, Nasdaq, Dow) and each stock's early move come into view.


## Macro Note 📝


July PCE inflation data also lands tonight, the Fed's preferred inflation gauge. Consensus expects core PCE up about 3.3% year over year. A hotter-than-expected print could add caution around the rate path, and that feeds risk appetite for tech stocks tonight.


## Conclusion


Tonight is one of the most data-packed sessions of the past month: one AI bellwether report, two supporting tech prints, and a key inflation release in a single session. Together they could set the tone for the rest of the week.


The key is to set your watchlist early and track not just the numbers but the forward guidance and the market's reaction. Remember, this is not a promise of direction, just a map of what to watch. What stocks are you watching tonight?
